independent_probe.source:
"""Independent temporary review probes; production/source assets are never modified."""
import collections
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from fastfill.comparison import visual_pipeline as pipeline, visual_cases, render_assets as render
from fastfill.comparison.tests import test_visual_resource_binding as fixtures
from fastfill.comparison.tests import test_visual_pipeline as legacy


@pytest.mark.parametrize("phase", ["before", "after"])
def test_identical_texture_bytes_at_different_resolved_path_are_rejected(tmp_path, monkeypatch, phase):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path)
    texture = inputs[3]["0-original-a"]["texture"]
    alternate = texture.parent / "same-bytes.png"
    alternate.write_bytes(texture.read_bytes())
    def swap():
        texture.unlink()
        texture.symlink_to(alternate)
    if phase == "before":
        swap()
    out, result, _ = fixtures.prepare(tmp_path, monkeypatch, inputs, during=swap if phase == "after" else None)
    fixtures.assert_inventory(out, result, inputs[0], {"room-0"})
    assert fixtures.read(out / "ledger.json")["cases"][0]["failure"]["phase"] == phase + "_render"


def test_right_resource_record_under_wrong_key_cannot_bind_room(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path)
    ref = inputs[0]
    resources = fixtures.read(ref / "resources.json")
    key = next(k for k, r in resources.items() if r["asset_id"] == "0-original-a")
    altered = {k: v for k, v in resources.items() if k != key}
    altered["0" * 64] = resources[key]
    legacy.write(ref / "resources.json", altered)
    fixtures.reseal(ref)
    out, result, _ = fixtures.prepare(tmp_path, monkeypatch, inputs)
    fixtures.assert_inventory(out, result, ref, {"room-0"})


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", ["uid", "asset_id", "mesh_path", "source"])
def test_unsealed_case_mapping_identity_edit_aborts_before_render(tmp_path, monkeypatch, field):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path)
    ref = inputs[0]
    cases = visual_cases._read_rows(ref / "reference-cases.jsonl")
    changed = copy.deepcopy(cases)
    changed[0]["asset_mapping"][0][field] = "foreign-value"
    legacy.rows(ref / "reference-cases.jsonl", changed)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pipeline.subprocess, "run", lambda *a, **k: pytest.fail("render launched"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="hash mismatch"):
        pipeline.prepare(ref, inputs[1], tmp_path / "visual", "/mock")
    assert not (tmp_path / "visual").exists()


def test_shared_asset_inspection_is_cached_once_per_pass_and_fresh_after_render(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path, shared=True)
    original = render.inspect_asset
    calls = []
    def inspect(path, asset_id):
        calls.append((path, asset_id))
        return original(path, asset_id)
    monkeypatch.setattr(render, "inspect_asset", inspect)
    out, result, _ = fixtures.prepare(tmp_path, monkeypatch, inputs)
    fixtures.assert_inventory(out, result, inputs[0], set())
    assert len(calls) == 4
    assert set(collections.Counter(calls).values()) == {2}


def test_postcheck_drift_never_publishes_failed_room_to_fid_or_api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path)
    texture = inputs[3]["0-original-a"]["texture"]
    out, result, _ = fixtures.prepare(tmp_path, monkeypatch, inputs, during=lambda: texture.write_bytes(b"DRIFT"))
    fixtures.assert_inventory(out, result, inputs[0], {"room-0"})
    _, cases, _ = pipeline.fid._load_manifest(out / "fid-manifest.json")
    checked, failures = pipeline.fid._inspect_cases(cases, out)
    assert len(checked) == 3 and not checked["room-0"]["candidate"]
    assert checked["room-0"]["images"] == {}
    assert len([r for r in failures if r["uid"] == "room-0"]) == 4
    for arm in pipeline.ARMS[1:]:
        identity = render.json_sha256(["room-0", arm])
        assert not (out / "api-bundle/images" / identity).exists()
    assert not (out / "api-bundle/prompts" / (render.json_sha256("room-0") + ".txt")).exists()
    assert len(fixtures.read(out / "api-mapping.json")) == 6
    assert len(fixtures.read(out / "api-failures.json")) == 2
    # Raw chunk images are diagnostic only; authoritative manifests above exclude them.
    assert len(list((out / "chunks").rglob("*.png"))) == 18
    assert len(list((out / "api-bundle/images").rglob("*.png"))) == 8


def test_boundary_check_limit_transient_drift_restored_before_postcheck(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    inputs = fixtures.cohort(tmp_path)
    texture = inputs[3]["0-original-a"]["texture"]
    frozen = texture.read_bytes()
    fake = legacy.fake_blender([])
    def transient(command, **kwargs):
        texture.write_bytes(b"temporary-render-time-drift")
        try:
            return fake(command, **kwargs)
        finally:
            texture.write_bytes(frozen)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pipeline.subprocess, "run", transient)
    out = tmp_path / "visual"
    result = pipeline.prepare(inputs[0], inputs[1], out, "/mock", workers=1, eval_data=inputs[2])
    # Explicit limit characterization, not a guarantee of immutable Blender reads.
    fixtures.assert_inventory(out, result, inputs[0], set())

limitations.description: No immutable staging/read attestation. Temporary asset drift during mocked rendering restored before postcheck is accepted. This demonstrates a boundary-check limit, not actual Blender pixel correctness. Cached passes also do not continuously monitor each read.

Raw chunk PNGs and receipts remain after resource failure; final authoritative image entries, FID candidates and runnable API bundle exclude them. Consumers must follow final manifests and must not glob raw chunk images or promote nested receipt paths.
No real Blender rendering, FID feature extraction, paid judge execution, full-real-asset-byte reaudit, or resource-I/O benchmark was performed. Parent owns the full suite and deployment decision.

Requested fastfill/comparison/resource_binding.py is absent. Actual implementation is visual_pipeline._resource_failures and imports no such helper; author report says no helper was necessary. Verdict covers only enumerated existing hashes.

The supplied frozen reference manifest is trusted provenance, not signed authentication against a hostile actor who can consistently replace manifest/cases/resource book. Hashes detect drift relative to that supplied freeze.

review_scope: VIS-01 persistent resource drift at pre/post rendering boundaries; independent read-only review
